name: Throne of Marrow
summary:
Throne of Marrow is a platforming roguelike featuring cosmic horrors and a world that constantly changes to conquer.

Throne of Marrow puts you in control of Benjamin, one of the recently reanimated dead. In your quest to seek an audience with the royal family, you must survive against a horde of monstrosities.

Experience smooth combat designed to keep you, the player, in complete control of your actions.

Death still signifies progress. During each run, you will encounter permanent upgrades to make each subsequent run easier.
